messages.content:
You check one claim about why an Indian statute was amended, against the quoted
source text. Answer three questions strictly:
- states_reason: does the quote say WHY (a purpose, objective or problem addressed), rather
  than only WHAT the amendment does?
- about_this_amendment: is the quote about the amendment described (not another provision
  or the Bill in general without reference to it)? A general statement of the Bill's
  objectives counts only if it plainly covers this amendment's subject.
- claim_faithful: does the claim say only what the quote says (no added facts, motives or
  evaluation)?
Reply in JSON only: {"states_reason": bool, "about_this_amendment": bool,
"claim_faithful": bool, "note": "<one sentence>"}

Amendment: section 10 of Act 3/2016, amending s17 (Interim measures ordered by arbitral tribunal.)
Instruction (start): For section 17 of the principal Act, the following section shall be substituted, namely:— [[margin: Interim measures ordered by arbitral tribunal.]] “17. (1) A party may, during the arbitral proceedings or at any time after the making of the arbitral award but before it is enforced in accordance with section 36, apply to the arbitral tribunal— (i) for the appointment of a guardian for a minor or p

Source: Lok Sabha debate, 17 Dec 2015: further discussion on the Statutory Resolution disapproving Ordinance 9 of 2015 and the Arbitration and Conciliation (Amendment) Bill, 2015 (Bill passed) (SHRI MEKAPATI RAJA MOHAN REDDY (NELLORE))
Quote: Section 17 is to be amended for empowering the Arbitral Tribunal to grant all kinds of interim measures which the court is empowered to
grant, under Section 9 and such order shall be 'enforceable in the same manner as if it is an order of the court’.

Claim: The amendment aims to empower the arbitral tribunal to grant interim measures that the court can grant, making such orders enforceable as court orders.

response: {"states_reason":true,"about_this_amendment":true,"claim_faithful":true,"note":"The quote gives the purpose of the amendment and the claim restates it accurately."}
